description: Defines classes, enums, and functions related to web request handling, including request serialization/deserialization, MIME types, signatures, authorization, and request structure within the Thunder Web namespace.

classes.name: IBody
classes.description: Interface for request/response body serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic signature with type and hash value.

classes.name: Authorization
classes.description: Represents HTTP authorization with type and token.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/WebSocket request with methods for serialization, deserialization, and management of request data.

methods.name: MIMETypeAndEncodingForFile
methods.description: External function to determine MIME type and encoding for a given file path.

methods.name: Request::ToString
methods.description: Serializes a Request object into a string.

methods.name: Request::FromString
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a Request object.

methods.name: Request::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the request has a valid verb.

methods.name: Request::Clear
methods.description: Resets the request to default/empty state.

methods.name: Request::Body
methods.description: Sets or gets the body of the request.

methods.name: Request::ScanForKeyword
methods.description: Checks if a keyword exists in a buffer string.
